title: ChatGPT and Gemini disagree on the best software in a third of categories, and the review sites have been skipped
excerpt: ChatGPT and Gemini name a different #1 software in a third of 126 categories, a 9,978-answer study found. Review sites got just 5% of all citations.
content_html:
GetIntel published its AI Software Index on Wednesday. The study asked roughly 80 buyer-phrased questions in each of 126 software categories, covering 1,825 brands. The questions went to the live ChatGPT and Gemini consumer apps rather than the developer APIs. That produced 9,978 usable answers, all collected on 6 August.

The headline result is a coin toss. In one category out of every three, the two assistants name a different number one. Which chatbot a buyer happens to open decides which company gets recommended.

Look at what the assistants actually cite. The most-cited domain across the whole study was techradar.com, with 1,114 citations. Reddit came second on 807 and Zapier third on 418. G2, Capterra and TrustRadius together accounted for 5% of all citations.

That is an industry being routed around. Those three sites exist to be the reference layer for software buying. A consumer tech magazine and a forum are now doing that job instead. Gartner managed 238 citations, fewer than Zapier.

Reddit sitting second is its own problem. The platform is already cracking down on brands seeding fake opinions for chatbots to repeat. It says it now catches 25,000 such posts a day. The assistants are leaning hardest on the source that is hardest to keep clean.

ChatGPT sends traffic. Gemini does not

The two behave very differently once they have picked a winner. When ChatGPT recommends a product, it cites that product’s own website 53% of the time. Gemini does so in only 13% of cases. It leans on third-party pages instead.

So the same recommendation is worth different amounts. Winning inside ChatGPT delivers a link. Winning inside Gemini delivers a mention. That distinction matters to anyone still measuring publisher traffic as the outcome.

Gemini’s independent sources are stranger still. Its most-cited third-party pages are blog posts written by other software companies. The study notes these are often about categories the publishing company has nothing to do with.

The answer changes with who is asking, and where

Saying who you are moves the result. In some categories a brand goes from winning 34% of answers to winning 90%. The only change is whether the buyer says “I’m a freelancer” or “we’re an enterprise”. Same category, same question, different customer.

Geography moves it too, and this is the finding a European reader should sit with. The number one recommendation flips between US-phrased and UK-phrased versions of the same question. That happened in about half the categories the study could measure. Regulators have spent two years arguing about whether AI answers opt out fairly. Nobody has asked whether they answer the same question the same way on both sides of the Atlantic.

Showing up and winning are not the same

The leaderboard data is unkind to the obvious names. HubSpot appears on more category leaderboards than anyone, 19 of them, and wins three. Salesforce appears on 13 and wins none at all. QuickBooks appears on seven and wins five.

Some categories are already settled. GitHub is the first recommendation in 91% of CI/CD answers and 72% of code review answers. Shopify takes 84% of e-commerce and Miro 83% of whiteboards. Square holds 78% of point of sale and Loom 76% of screen recording.

Others are wide open. In affiliate marketing software the top pick wins only 5% of answers. Contract management sits at 13%. Invoicing, live chat and order fulfilment all sit at 19%. The winner there changes almost every time the question is reworded.

Who measured this, and why

The caveat is the whole business model. GetIntel is a Bengaluru company that sells AI visibility software. Its full index concludes that companies do not know whether AI names them. That is also its sales pitch. Founder Tarang Agarwal says so nearly outright.

Agarwal puts the problem plainly. A company can quote its Google ranking to the decimal, he said. It may have no idea whether ChatGPT has ever named it. “Closing that gap is the entire reason an AI visibility tool exists.”

It is a crowded pitch. Berlin’s Peec AI reached a $200m valuation selling the same promise. The practical work of earning citations still looks a lot like ranking on Google.

The method has real limits and they are worth stating. This is one day of data from two engines, with no error bars and no peer review. “Top pick” simply means the first brand named in an answer, which is a blunt measure of a nuanced reply. A single snapshot cannot show whether any of this is stable.

Which is the test worth setting. GetIntel says it will refresh the Index quarterly. If the disagreement rate is still near a third in November, buyers really are getting different answers from different machines. If it collapses, this was a photograph of a moving object.

content_html_zh:
GetIntel 周三发布了人工智能软件指数。 该研究在 126 个软件类别中询问了大约 80 个买家提出的问题，涵盖 1,825 个品牌。 问题针对的是实时 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 消费者应用程序，而不是开发人员 API。 产生了 9,978 个可用答案，全部收集于 8 月 6 日。

标题结果是掷硬币。 在每三个类别中的一个类别中，两位助理给出了不同的第一名。 买家打开哪个聊天机器人决定了推荐哪家公司。

看看助理们实际上引用了什么。 整个研究中被引用最多的域名是 techradar.com，有 1,114 次引用。 Reddit 在 807 上排名第二，Zapier 在 418 上排名第三。 G2、Capterra 和 TrustRadius 合计占所有引用的 5%。

这是一个正在被绕行的行业。 这三个网站的存在是为了作为软件购买的参考层。 一家消费科技杂志和一个论坛现在正在做这项工作。 Gartner 管理了 238 次引用，少于 Zapier。

Reddit 排名第二是它自己的问题。 该平台已经在打击那些散布虚假观点供聊天机器人重复的品牌。 该公司表示，现在每天可以捕获 25,000 个此类帖子。 助手们最依赖最难保持清洁的源头。

ChatGPT 发送流量。 双子座没有

一旦选出获胜者，两人的行为就截然不同。 当 ChatGPT 推荐产品时，53% 的情况下它会引用该产品自己的网站。 双子座只在 13% 的情况下这样做。 相反，它依赖于第三方页面。

所以同样的推荐值不同的金额。 在 ChatGPT 内获胜会提供一个链接。 双子座内部的胜利值得一提。 对于仍在衡量发布商流量作为结果的任何人来说，这种区别很重要。

双子座的独立消息来源更奇怪。 其引用次数最多的第三方页面是其他软件公司撰写的博客文章。 研究指出，这些内容通常与出版公司无关。

答案会根据提问者和地点的不同而变化

说出你是谁会改变结果。 在某些类别中，品牌从赢得 34% 的答案上升到赢得 90% 的答案。 唯一的变化是买家说“我是自由职业者”还是“我们是企业”。 相同的类别，相同的问题，不同的客户。

地理因素也会影响它，这是欧洲读者应该接受的发现。 第一个建议是在同一问题的美国用语和英国用语版本之间切换。 该研究可以衡量的类别中约有一半发生了这种情况。 监管机构花了两年时间争论人工智能答案是否公平地选择退出。 没有人问过大西洋两岸的人是否以同样的方式回答同样的问题。

出现和获胜是不一样的

排行榜数据对那些显而易见的名字并不友好。 HubSpot 出现在排行榜上的类别数量最多，共 19 个，并赢得了 3 个冠军。 Salesforce 排名第 13 位，但没有获胜。 QuickBooks 出现在七场比赛中，并赢得了五场胜利。

有些类别已经确定。 GitHub 是 91% 的 CI/CD 答案和 72% 的代码审查答案中的第一推荐。 Shopify 占据了 84% 的电子商务份额，Miro 占据了 83% 的白板份额。 Square 拥有 78% 的销售点份额，Loom 则拥有 76% 的屏幕录制份额。

其他人则敞开心扉。 在联盟营销软件中，首选只能赢得 5% 的答案。 合同管理占 13%。 发票、实时聊天和订单履行均占 19%。 几乎每次问题被改写时，获胜者都会改变。

谁测量了这个，为什么

需要注意的是整个商业模式。 GetIntel 是一家班加罗尔公司，销售人工智能可视性软件。 其完整指数得出的结论是，公司不知道人工智能是否为它们命名。 这也是它的销售宣传。 创始人塔朗·阿加瓦尔 (Tarang Agarwal) 几乎是直截了当地说的。

阿加瓦尔把问题说得很清楚。 他说，一家公司可以将其谷歌排名引用到小数点。 它可能不知道 ChatGPT 是否曾经命名过它。 “缩小这一差距是人工智能可视性工具存在的全部原因。”

这是一个拥挤的球场。 柏林的 Peec AI 也做出了同样的承诺，估值达到 2 亿美元。 获得引用的实际工作看起来仍然很像在谷歌上排名。

该方法确实有局限性，值得说明。 这是来自两个引擎的一天数据，没有误差线，也没有同行评审。 “首选”只是指答案中提到的第一个品牌，这是对细致入微的回复的直率衡量。 单个快照无法表明其中任何一个是否稳定。

这是值得设置的测试。 GetIntel 表示将每季度刷新该指数。 如果 11 月份的分歧率仍然接近三分之一，那么买家确实会从不同的机器上得到不同的答案。 如果它倒塌了，这就是一张移动物体的照片。
